collection.title: VW Bora Estate 1998 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Bora Estate 1998 to 2001 model requires a 21" wiper blade for the drivers and a 19" passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle and are the the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
